business_summary: CGN Nuclear Technology Development Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of electron accelerators in China. The company offers high-energy linear accelerator, earth nano accelerator, electronic curtain accelerator, dg resonant transformer type accelerator, industrial flaw detection accelerator, and electron beam. It also provides irradiation sterilization and polymer material irradiation modification services. In addition, the company offers cable polymer materials, such as PVC cable material, POE cable material, and PE sheath material; fiber optic cables using tight-buffered TPEE, TPV, and TPO; biodegradable film bag and straw modification materials; modified nylon (pa), including high CTI bromine-based flame retardant, red phosphorus flame retardant, nitrogen flame retardant, high temperature resistant, toughened PA, and reinforced PA; and flame-retardant modified polycarbonate (PC), reinforced PC, PG/PBT alloy, PC/ABS alloy, light-diffusing PC. Further, it provides modified polyester; fiberglass reinforced modified polypropylene (PP), mineral-filled PP, toughened PP, high-gloss PP, flame-retardant PP, and weather-resistant PP; HDPE prepreg tape material, PP prepreg tape material, and PA prepreg tape material; high melt flow index meltblown PP and radiation-resistant sterilization meltblown PP; and radiation-resistant polypropylene products. Additionally, the company offers healthcare products comprising proton therapy tumor system equipment and radioactive medical isotopes; and measurement and control equipment, including silicon photomultiplier. The company was formerly known as China Dalian International Cooperation (Group) Holdings Ltd. and changed its name to CGN Nuclear Technology Development Co., Ltd. in February 2017. CGN Nuclear Technology Development Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
